signature.name: VTask.smulTorsor
signature.type: {𝕜 : Type u_1} -> {E : Type u_2} -> [NormedDivisionRing 𝕜] -> [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] -> [Module 𝕜 E] -> [NormSMulClass 𝕜 E] -> {P : Type u_3} -> [PseudoMetricSpace P] -> [NormedAddTorsor E P] -> (c : P) -> {k : 𝕜} -> (hk : k ≠ 0) -> E ≃ᵈ P

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The only potential junk value arises when k = 0, but this is explicitly excluded by the hypothesis hk : k ≠ 0, so the construction is total on its stated domain with no junk-value convention needed.
